## Need
For the figures and tables: (1) the chosen venue and template, (2) text width and column width in pt/inches, (3) the venue's minimum type size for figures, (4) the main-text page limit and how many main figures/tables fit, (5) whether colour figures are allowed / print assumptions, (6) whether the appendix counts toward the limit.
## For
Figures are rendered at the final placed width with text ≥ the venue minimum; which items are main vs appendix follows the page budget (story's priority: Table 2+Fig 2, Fig 3, Fig 5, Fig 4, Fig 6).

Result files from which I draw Fig. 2–6 and Tables 1–4 (outline `Outline` §1, claims C1–C5), in a documented tidy schema, committed in `experiment-repo` (CSV/parquet; LFS if large).
